market_stress_band: Cross-asset stress score below its historical 50th percentile
purpose: Reference case. No scenario shock applied.

market_stress_band: Cross-asset score from the 50th to below the 90th percentile
purpose: Illustrative deterioration scenario with higher probability of default, loss severity, and drawdown risk.

market_stress_band: Cross-asset stress score at or above its historical 90th percentile
purpose: Illustrative tail-stress scenario. Intended for capital, provisioning, concentration, and watchlist review.
